# Insurans.co

> Malaysia's BM-first (Bahasa Malaysia) insurance guide with calculated premium estimates (not quotes), company profiles and practical guides. Written for ordinary Malaysians — not agents or brokers.

Insurans.co covers car insurance, motorcycle insurance, health insurance, life insurance, home insurance, personal accident insurance, and takaful (Islamic insurance) in Malaysia. The site includes premium estimates, NCD (No-Claim Discount) tables, company profiles for 12 major insurers, and step-by-step guides for claims and renewals. Content is primarily in Bahasa Malaysia with some English terms.

## About & Contact

- Editor: [Amir Ariff](https://insurans.co/penulis/amir-ariff/) — Pengasas & Editor Insurans.co

## Main Pages

- [Homepage](https://insurans.co/): Overview of all insurance types available in Malaysia with quick links to each category
- [Car Insurance](https://insurans.co/car-insurance/): Comprehensive car insurance guide — premium estimates by car model, NCD table, comparison of comprehensive vs third-party coverage. Most popular page.

## Insurance Types

- [Car Insurance](https://insurans.co/car-insurance/): Premium estimates (e.g. Myvi RM680–990, Axia RM540–720 with 55% NCD), types of coverage, how premiums are calculated
- [Motorcycle Insurance](https://insurans.co/motorcycle-insurance/): Motorcycle insurance guide for Malaysia
- [Health Insurance](https://insurans.co/health-insurance/): Medical cards and health insurance plans in Malaysia
- [Life Insurance](https://insurans.co/life-insurance/): Term life, whole life, and investment-linked plans
- [Home Insurance](https://insurans.co/home-insurance/): Fire insurance and houseowner/householder policies
- [Personal Accident](https://insurans.co/personal-accident/): PA insurance covering accidental death, disability, and medical expenses
- [Takaful](https://insurans.co/takaful/): Shariah-compliant insurance alternative — how takaful works vs conventional insurance

## Company Profiles

12 insurance companies profiled with legal entity names, products, claim hotlines and sources. The site gives no star ratings or rankings:

- [Etiqa](https://insurans.co/companies/etiqa/): Etiqa General Insurance Berhad. Products covered: car, motorcycle, health, life, travel, home, personal accident. Takaful entity: Etiqa General Takaful Berhad.
- [Allianz](https://insurans.co/companies/allianz/): Allianz General Insurance Company (Malaysia) Berhad. Products covered: car, motorcycle, health, life, travel, home, personal accident.
- [Tokio Marine](https://insurans.co/companies/tokio-marine/): Tokio Marine Insurans (Malaysia) Berhad. Products covered: car, motorcycle, health, travel, home, personal accident.
- [AIA](https://insurans.co/companies/aia/): AIA Bhd. Products covered: car, health, life, personal accident. Takaful entity: AIA PUBLIC Takaful Bhd.
- [Great Eastern](https://insurans.co/companies/great-eastern/): Great Eastern Life Assurance (Malaysia) Berhad. Products covered: health, life, personal accident. Takaful entity: Great Eastern Takaful Berhad.
- [Zurich](https://insurans.co/companies/zurich/): Zurich General Insurance Malaysia Berhad. Products covered: car, motorcycle, health, life, travel, home. Takaful entity: Zurich General Takaful Malaysia Berhad.
- [Prudential](https://insurans.co/companies/prudential/): Prudential Assurance Malaysia Berhad. Products covered: health, life, personal accident. Takaful entity: Prudential BSN Takaful Berhad.
- [Takaful Malaysia](https://insurans.co/companies/takaful-malaysia/): Syarikat Takaful Malaysia Keluarga Berhad. Products covered: car, motorcycle, health, life, home, personal accident.
- [Berjaya Sompo](https://insurans.co/companies/berjaya-sompo/): Berjaya Sompo Insurance Berhad. Products covered: car, motorcycle, travel, home, personal accident. Not related to the Kurnia brand (now Liberty General).
- [MSIG](https://insurans.co/companies/msig/): MSIG Insurance (Malaysia) Bhd. Products covered: car, motorcycle, travel, home, personal accident.
- [RHB Insurance](https://insurans.co/companies/rhi/): RHB Insurance Berhad. Products covered: car, motorcycle, home, personal accident, travel.
- [Lonpac](https://insurans.co/companies/lonpac/): Lonpac Insurance Bhd. Products covered: car, motorcycle, home, personal accident, travel.
- [All Companies](https://insurans.co/companies/): Full directory of insurance companies in Malaysia

## Guides

- [How to Claim Insurance](https://insurans.co/guides/how-to-claim/): Step-by-step guide for making insurance claims in Malaysia
- [Insurance vs Takaful](https://insurans.co/guides/insurance-vs-takaful/): Key differences between conventional insurance and takaful
- [NCD Explained](https://insurans.co/guides/ncd-explained/): No-Claim Discount system — how it works, NCD table (25%→30%→38.33%→45%→55%)
- [How to Renew Car Insurance](https://insurans.co/guides/renew-car-insurance/): Online and offline renewal process for Malaysian car insurance
